subStrands.name: Letters, Memos, Form Letters and Manuscripts

objectives.description: Correspondence: letters and memoranda with insets, continuation sheets, subject headings, enclosures, attention lines, including private, personal, confidential and distribution of carbon copies; use of pre-printed A4 and A5 headed paper.
Form letters and circular letters with or without tear-off portions; envelope addressing; envelope with special marks.
Manuscript: typing from manuscript drafts with or without inset matter, including manuscript correction signs.

subStrands.name: Headings, Paragraphing, Tabulation, Meetings and Financial Statements

objectives.description: Headings: main, sub-heading, shoulder, paragraph and marginal/side heading. Paragraphing: blocked, indented and hanging paragraphs. Paragraph numbering: Arabic, Roman, decimal and alphabetical.
Display work: menu, advertisement, and itineraries. Meetings and report: notice of meetings (with or without agenda), chairman's agenda, minutes and reports.
Business Forms and Cards: completion of pre-printed forms — application and personal records forms, invoices, order forms, delivery note, advice note, invitation cards and postcards.

Tabulation: tabulation with ruling, with or without leader dots, chronological and alphabetical arrangements. Literary Work: short plays, poems and articles; footnotes. Financial Statement: simple statement of accounts.

subStrands.name: Typing Speed at 40 Words Per Minute

objectives.description: Speed and accuracy test at 40 words per minute (syllabic intensity 1.35–1.40); production of mailable documents; typing from manuscript, typescript and printed drafts with interpolations and correction signs; total standard words between 1350 and 1450.
